name: draw.io MCP
description: Lets AI assistants create and open draw.io diagrams from XML, CSV, or Mermaid, via a hosted MCP app server, an npm MCP server, or assistant plugins.

skills.name: Create Diagram
skills.description: Renders draw.io XML or Mermaid as an interactive diagram inline in MCP Apps hosts such as Claude.ai and ChatGPT.

skills.name: Search Shapes
skills.description: Searches 10,000+ shapes across draw.io libraries, including AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, UML, and BPMN.

skills.name: Open in Editor
skills.description: Opens XML, CSV, or Mermaid diagrams directly in the draw.io editor in a new browser tab.

skills.name: Auto Layout
skills.description: Re-arranges nodes with ELK layout or reroutes connectors around shapes with libavoid.

skills.name: File Export
skills.description: Writes native .drawio files from assistant plugins, with optional PNG, SVG, or PDF export via draw.io Desktop.
